items.name: Cow
items.ask: Who lives on the farm? Can you guess this shadow?
items.hint: It says moo, and it gives us milk!

items.name: Pig
items.hint: It has a round nose and loves to play in the mud!

items.name: Sheep
items.hint: It has soft, fluffy wool and says baa!

items.name: Horse
items.ask: Last one! Who is this shadow?
items.hint: It runs very fast and goes clip clop!

outro_screen:

How many did

seo.title: Guess the Farm Animal Shadow! 🐄🐖 Farm Animals for Kids | Shadow Game for Kids | Unique Kiddo
seo.description:
Can your little one guess the farm animal from its shadow? 🤔 Look, listen to the clue, and shout the answer with Kiddo!

A quick farm animals guessing game for kids. Children learn 4 farm animal names:
🐄 Cow
🐖 Pig
🐑 Sheep
🐎 Horse

Each round has think time so kids can guess, and a "say it with me" pause to practise new English words. Great for toddlers, preschool and kindergarten (ages 2–6).

⭐ Subscribe to Unique Kiddo for more Guess with Kiddo games: animals, vehicles, sports, letters and more!

Voice: Kokoro TTS (Apache 2.0) · Emoji art: Noto Emoji (Apache 2.0)
